analysis.summary: During the fiscal year 2025-26, GNA Axles experienced a 4% decline in total revenue to ` 1,478.42 Cr, primarily due to export headwinds and tariffs imposed by the US government, which adversely affected export sales. However, robust domestic demand from tractor and commercial vehicle segments, alongside improved cost structures and operating efficiencies, enabled the company to expand its profitability, reporting a Profit After Tax of ` 116.99 Cr. Management highlighted strategic diversification into light vehicles, passenger vehicles, and SUVs, supported by subsidiaries like GNA Mobility Limited, to drive future growth and reduce reliance on traditional segments. Furthermore, the company continued its focus on advanced automation, integrated manufacturing, and renewable energy adoption to strengthen its operational foundation. Management reported a stable financial performance for the year ended March 31, 2025, with total net revenue increasing by 2.22% to ₹1,539.74 crores, driven primarily by export growth, while EBITDA margins remained stable at 13.68%.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for commercial vehicles is expected to improve from FY 2024-25.
demand_outlook.quote: With promising GDP growth outlook, incentives from government to improve productivity in both manufacturing and agriculture sectors, and continuing focus on infra, demand for CVs is expected to improve from FY 2024-25.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic tractor sales are expected to post a lower single digit growth this year.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as the Domestic Tractor Market is concerned we expect that the domestic sales are expected to post a lower single digit growth in this year as the Country expects a good monsoon this year which is expected to increase higher farm incomes and a lift in the rural economy.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that in 2025, GNA Mobility Limited was incorporated as a wholly owned subsidiary to expand presence in automotive components.
capex_expansion.quote: In 2025, we incorporated GNA Mobility Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary to expand our presence in automotive components.

capex_expansion.claim: The company installed a 1.4 MW rooftop solar power project and plans to expand solar capacity further in 2024-25.
capex_expansion.quote: This year, we installed a 1.4 MW rooftop solar power project, and we’re planning to expand our solar capacity even further in 2024-25.

margins_costs.claim: Management highlighted that optimizing capacity utilisation and strict cost control continue to enhance efficiency and strengthen operating leverage.
margins_costs.quote: Our emphasis on optimising capacity utilisation and maintaining strict cost control continues to enhance efficiency and strengthen operating leverage.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 13.68% for the financial year.

orders_capacity.claim: Management reported that rooftop solar capacity grew from 1.2 MW in 2023-24 to 6 MW in 2025-26.
orders_capacity.quote: Our rooftop solar capacity has grown from 1.2 MW in 2023-24 to 6 MW in 2025-26, reinforcing our commitment to clean energy and sustainable growth.

orders_capacity.claim: The company sold 3,882,041 rear axle shafts, 1,105,733 spindles, and 327,019 other shafts during 2024-25.
orders_capacity.quote: 3,882,041 Rear Axle Shafts Sold in 2024-25 1,105,733 Spindles sold in 2024-25 327,019 Other Shafts sold in 2024-25

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to expand solar capacity further in 2024-25.
management_commitments.quote: This year, we installed a 1.4 MW rooftop solar power project, and we’re planning to expand our solar capacity even further in 2024-25.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
